observation_format.evidence_quote: Leveraging the ad- vanced multi-modal capabilities of MLLMs, LIGER employs the state-of-the-art GPT4O model as an error detector
observation_format.note: Images (draft/previous) plus step text given to GPT-4o; 'screenshots' is the closest value for generated images.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the error detector outputs the error rectification instruction in the format of Regenerate(Newtext ), then regenerates an image according to the new description.
tool_call_format.note: Tool calls are function-call-style text commands (Regenerate/Modify/Add/Remove) parsed from model output; xml_tags is the closest value to text-parsed calls. Parser code not in evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote: The error detector flags the object to be removed in a format ofRemove(objectinV ′ i ), and the locator tool pinpoints the specific region.
tool_count.note: Commands per paper: Regenerate, Modify, Add, Remove (4) plus referee Compare; count derived from prose, not code.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Our method utilizes different image editing methods to rectify the errors in the image.
edit_primitive.note: No file editing; the edit tools operate on images (inpainting, removal, DragonDiffusion).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: In this paper, we aim to generate a series of images given task step descriptions.
